title: Knowledge-freshness close door: fix required_context resolution, scope to touched areas, repair areas/ pointers
action: Per plan v2 C1 (D1). (1) Fix the generator/check mismatch: check.rs:542-563 resolves required_context only inside the bundle, but promote.rs:549-554 writes docs/history/<f>/CONTEXT.md+plan.md there — resolve required_context against the bundle FIRST, then the repo root (dir.parent().parent() as dangling_source already does at check.rs:574-588); a docs/history path that exists on disk is not dangling. (2) New build_knowledge_freshness_door in close.rs: filter check warnings post-walk to prefixes areas/<touched>/ (touched_bundle_areas, close.rs:895-918) + work/<feature>/; dangling_source + dangling_required_context in scope => blocking:true with per-file remedy detail; not_canonical/invalid_evidence_state stay report-only in detail. Deferral escape shaped like has_capture_deferral_decision (close.rs:663-676): a decision citing knowledge-freshness + the feature defers with reason in detail. Slot the door after pattern-check in the exit chain (close.rs:1266 precedent) and into all three doors vecs (close.rs:1061, 1111, 1188). (3) Repair the 6 existing areas/ dangling sources listed in files[] — each names a retired path; point to the live Rust equivalent or remove the entry with a one-line reason in place. Tests in drivers/tests.rs: dangling source in touched area refuses close; same warning in untouched area is clear; deferral decision makes it non-blocking with named reason; no bundle => door absent; a promoted delivery file whose required_context names docs/history paths resolves clean after (1).

truths: bee knowledge check reports zero dangling_required_context after the resolution fix (all 13 current ones resolve via repo root)
close refuses when a touched area holds a dangling_source and names the file and remedy
a recorded deferral decision demotes the door to non-blocking with the reason in the detail line
the 6 areas/ dangling_source warnings are gone
